tiṣyate,
tatsūtraṃ
prajñāsaṃskārātiśayasya
punarjanmāhetutve
hetvantaraparatayāvatārayati--
kiṃ
cāsyeti
/
Tasya
prajñāsaṃskārasyānyac
ca
phalaṃ
sarvavṛttitatsaṃskārayor nirodho bhavati, iti na punarjanmasaṃbhāvanety arthaḥ / Tasyāpi nirodhe
sarvanirodhān nirbījaḥ samādhiḥ / Pūrvapūrvāsaṃprajñāte tāvat prajñaiva nirudhyate,
prajñāsaṃskārasya tu tānavamātraṃ bhavati / Evaṃ krameṇa tu tasyāpi prajñākṛtasaṃskārasyāpy
asaṃprajñātaparaṃparāyā nirodhe'tyantābhibhave jāyamāne caramāsaṃprajñāto nirbīja-yogasya parā
kāṣṭhā bhavaty apunarvyutthānety arthaḥ / Sarva-nirodhād iti sūtra-avayavena nirbījatve hetur
uktaḥ / Yataḥ prajñā tatsaṃskāraś ca sarvo'py
